messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: API-GW-502-504 spike detected — 5xx > 5% threshold in us-west-2. Pager: alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): seeing large spike of 502/504 on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Started ~12:03 UTC. Error rate ~11% right now. Triage thread.

maria (sre): checking edge/gateway logs and autoscale. Initial glance shows 'upstream timed out' and 'upstream prematurely closed connection' in nginx.

ashwin (api): confirming many 504s from gw->runtime. p50 latency ok, but p95+ huge. Looks like backend worker crashes/timeouts. Pulling runtime logs.

carla (product): are customers affected? support is getting tickets. Any high-touch accounts impacted?

jordan (support): yes, two enterprise customers reported timeouts: AcmeCorp and FinData. They're seeing failing requests in batch jobs. Escalated.

alex (oncall): mitigation ideas: rollback experimental routing that sharded traffic to new runtime pool, increase runtime capacity, and enable a fallback stable model variant. I'll start rollback now. @ashwin can you scale runtime?

ashwin (api): scaling runtime pools up by +30% and increasing gw->runtime timeout to 90s as temporary. Also enabling fallback routing to model-v1-stable. Applying now.

maria (sre): pulling nginx error logs: a lot of 'recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)' from hosts r-54-*. Also see OOM signals on runtime hosts around the same time.

statusbot: Incident status: mitigation in progress — rollback and scaling underway.

alex (oncall): also kicking off a host reboot of the busiest runtime nodes (r-54-2/3). Maria, can you run tcpdump on a sample gateway host and share capture?

maria (sre): captured packet trace and uploaded to /tmp/gw-capture-1770551234.pcap. Observed SYN/ACK then RST from runtime processes. Runtime logs show processes killed by OOM killer.

ashwin (api): checking recent model variant deploy — quantization/config change increased memory footprint. Reverting that variant and routing to model-v1-stable should reduce pressure. Revert pushed.

carla (product): recommend status page update. Jordan, can you post interim message?

jordan (support): Drafting: 'We are investigating elevated API errors (502/504) affecting some requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we will provide updates every 15 minutes.' Shall I publish?

alex (oncall): publish it. Also notify Account Execs for AcmeCorp & FinData.

statusbot: Status page updated.

maria (sre): rollback + scale shows initial impact: 5xx rate down from 11.6% -> 4.2% over the last 5m. Some residual 504s remain from older hosts. Restart of r-54-3 completed, no further OOMs on that host.

ashwin (api): rolling a temporary config to limit per-request KV cache size to prevent runaway memory for large prompts. Will hold 60s and monitor.

alex (oncall): good. Action list for immediate: 1) rollback experimental routing (done), 2) increase runtime nodes (done), 3) enable fallback model (done), 4) restart problematic hosts (in progress), 5) status page update (done).

statusbot: Metrics: 5xx rate trending down; p95 latency improving from 4.5s -> 1.2s. Still seeing small number of 504s from older nodes.

maria (sre): running fleet memory histogram and adding OOM alert. Also cordoning noisy hosts for deeper analysis.

ashwin (api): found correlated deploy of model-quant-tweak at 11:58 UTC — will add pre-rollout memory canary for model variants.

carla (product): blocking new model rollouts until we have the memory canary and a stricter canary target. Adding as follow-up.

jordan (support): created tickets for affected customers and sent initial notification to AEs. I'll keep the list in the support doc and DM the customers.

alex (oncall): heads-up: I need to handoff in ~25m. Maria, can you take primary lead after that? Please ensure postmortem and runbook updates.

maria (sre): taking lead. I'll create incident-followup/1770551234 and assign action items: memory canary, OOM alerts, model rollout gates.

alex (oncall): agreed. If 5xx rate crosses 6% re-page the oncall immediately.

statusbot: Incident severity downgraded to partial outage. Next automated update in 30 minutes.

---
Incident timeline summary: root_ts=1770551234 (detected 12:03 UTC). Key events: experimental routing rollback at 12:07, scaling + fallback model enabled by 12:10, partial recovery observed 12:18, handoff planned at 12:28.

Post-incident immediate action items (short):
- maria (sre): lead postmortem and create follow-up doc;
- ashwin (api): implement pre-rollout memory canary for model variants;
- sre team: add OOM alert & fleet memory histogram dashboards;
- product: block model rollouts until canary is in place.

Notes: root cause appears to be a model variant/quantization change that increased per-request memory leading to OOMs on runtime workers, which caused upstream resets and gateway 502/504 spikes. Temporary mitigations were rollback, scaling, and fallback routing.
